thread:
Diego (Marketing): Heads up — we need a compact set of benchmark graphics + responsive social/web heroes for the upcoming 'Serving Wins' milestone. Main asks: accessible contrast, 3 copy variations for AB test, and a webinar slide hero. Deadline: next Tues EOD.

Ben (Creative Ops): Got it. Can you list exact deliverables and preferred file types? also need the primary CTA copy.

Diego (Marketing): Deliverables:
- Benchmark tile (primary): PNG + SVG + figma components
- Social hero variants: LinkedIn/Twitter/IG/carousel sizes + mobile banner
- Webinar hero slide (1920x1080) + 16:9 export
- One-pager micro-diagram (png + pdf) showing latency vs $/token sparkline
- Contrast matrix screenshot for accessibility review
Preferred: SVG for vector, 2x PNGs for socials; include small-screen exports. CTA: "Try Redwood Inference" (we may test "Ship with Redwood" as alt).

Ava (Design): Quick q: what are the approved brand colors for this kit? do we need high-contrast dark-mode versions? Also we should know localization needs so I can allocate type lockups.

Priya (Product Marketing): Copy options (short):
A) "Lower latency. Fewer dollars. Predictable inference."
B) "Run LLMs reliably — at scale and at cost."
C) "Serve smarter: faster responses, lower unit cost."
Use A as default. Localization: yes, we'll need EN + DE + FR for launch markets, but only EN for social teasers initially.

Eli (Legal): Flag: avoid claims like exact % cost savings unless we include source/benchmark note. If we say "lower unit cost" that's fine, but any numerics need a citation and approval. Send the benchmark data or footnote text.

Ben (Creative Ops): Noted. For exports I'll do SVG, PNG@1x and PNG@2x. For social specs: please confirm pixel sizes. Also can't promise animations this sprint.

Diego (Marketing): Social sizes: LinkedIn hero 1200x628, X/Twitter 1600x900, Instagram feed 1080x1080, carousel 1080x1350, mobile banner 640x360. Webinar hero 1920x1080. One-pager 8.5x11 PDF export. Include crop-safe margins.

Ava (Design): Awesome. I'll set up a single Figma file with variant components and auto-layout. Planning to produce: primary dark BG tiles, light BG tiles, and a high-contrast monochrome variant for accessibility. Will include a contrast matrix screenshot and alt-text suggestions.

Ava (Design): FWIW, here's a quick breakpoint guide I'll follow:
```
/* quick export breakpoints */
--hero-desktop: 1920x1080;
--hero-tablet: 1200x675;
--hero-mobile: 640x360;
```
I'll ensure text scales and truncates nicely.

figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-benchpack — components: /bench-tiles, /social-heroes, /webinar-slide

Ben (Creative Ops): Thanks — will pull from that file. Priya, can you drop the final approved micro-copy into the figma file (copy layer) and add the legal footnote text if we add numeric claims?

Priya (Product Marketing): Done — added the three copy variations and a "data footnote" layer placeholder. For the sparkline claim, we'll use: "Based on internal workload tests; results vary by model and config." Eli, that should be better than a percent?

Eli (Legal): That wording is okay for now. If marketing wants to state a specific multiplier or percent we need the underlying test plan and raw numbers. Keep the footnote visible on the one-pager export.

Diego (Marketing): Final ask: can we also get a variant that visually calls out "Dedicated vs Hosted" routing benefits for the webinar slide (a small two-column callout)? That helps the narrative.

Ava (Design): Yes — two-column callout on slide. Also will include a small icon set (routing, latency, cost). If you need bespoke icons, tell me now, otherwise I'll use existing icon tokens.

Ben (Creative Ops): Timeline check: Ava — can you deliver first pass in 3 business days? I can QA and do exports in 1 day after.

Ava (Design): 3 business days works. Will tag issues in Figma for localization and export specs.

Diego (Marketing): Perfect. I'll circulate copy approvals and the benchmark note to Eli. Priya — please prioritize EN assets for socials; DE/FR will come after the first round.

Priya (Product Marketing): Roger. I'll also prep a short webinar slide script to match the visuals.

Ben (Creative Ops): Cool — I'll queue the exports and draft a small delivery checklist:
- SVG master + PNG@1x/2x per size
- PDF one-pager with footnote
- Figma component library link + handoff notes
- Accessibility contrast screenshots

Diego (Marketing): Thanks team. If anyone hits scope creep (animations, additional languages) call it out early. :thumbsup:

Ava (Design): Will do. Ping me here if legal wants in-frame footnote placement changes.

Eli (Legal): I'll review the footnote in the exported PDF before distribution.

Ben (Creative Ops): Marking kickoff in the file. :rocket:
